United Launch Alliance's corporate parents have guaranteed a loan to the company as it addresses "financial challenges" caused by the grounding of its Vulcan Centaur rocket, according to [SpaceNews](https://spacenews.com/ula-deals-with-financial-challenges-caused-by-vulcan-grounding/).
